name: open-msupply
//: Main version for the app, should be in semantic version format (any release candidate or test build should be separated by '-' i.e. 1.1.1-rc1 or 1.1.1-test

scripts.start: cd ./server && cargo run & cd ./client && yarn start-local
scripts.build: cd ./client && yarn build && cd ../server && cargo build --release
scripts.test: cd ./server && ulimit -n 1000 && cargo test && cd ../client && yarn test
scripts.//fetch-frontend: Fetches the pinned open-msupply-frontend dist (frontend-version.json) into server/frontend, where a server run from server/ serves it at /. Defaults to the public B2 mirror so no GitHub token is needed — the FE repo is private, and the pin's sha256 is enforced either way. Override FRONTEND_DIST_BASE_URL, or FRONTEND_DIST_URL for a local zip.
scripts.load-test: cd scripts/load-testing && mkdir -p output && k6 run main.js
